title: Stochastic simulation and applications in finance

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply stochastic simulation techniques in financial models.
Utilize Monte Carlo methods for financial decision-making and modeling.
Develop financial models using stochastic simulation techniques.
Apply programming skills in R for stochastic simulation and financial analysis.
Perform statistical analysis using stochastic simulation techniques.
Apply stochastic simulation to assess and manage financial risks.
Develop independent learning and problem-solving skills.
Work effectively in teams and manage group projects.
Analyze and interpret financial data using stochastic simulation.
Solve complex financial problems using stochastic simulation techniques.
